description:
Get the account budget

The account's budget: every key's spend together, its customers' keys included (their calls debit the account's balance), with each limit's spend this window. 404 not_found when the account has none. Windows are UTC: the day from midnight, the week from Monday, the month from the 1st, lifetime from when that limit was set.
name: get_account_budget
title: Get the account budget
